name: Carindale Property Trust
summary: Carindale Property Trust is situated in an affluent quarter of Brisbane's south eastern suburbs approximately 12 kilometres from the CBD. The centre currently services a trade area population of over 738,000, and has a total accessible market of 1.4 million residents with the nearby Gateway Motorway offering convenient access to the centre. One of the city's leading retail and lifestyle destinations, Westfield Carindale is home to many of Australia's most well-known retailers including David Jones, Myer, Kmart, Big W, Target, Coles, Woolworths, ALDI and Apple, as well as a host of premium fashion brands.
